tools.name: query_ai_act_updates
tools.description: Query EU AI Act regulatory updates from primary sources, newest first. Filters (date range, source, topics, severity) apply to the whole register before limit. Every event has the same shape in all tools: id, source_id, event_type, severity, topics, title_en, title_de, summary_en, summary_de, url_of

tools.name: get_obligation_for_role
tools.description: Look up the AI Act obligations for a specific role and AI-system risk category. Returns the relevant articles, deadlines, official sources and the most recent events for the primary article. This is informational, not legal advice.

tools.name: summarize_changes_since
tools.description: Generate a structured digest of AI Act regulatory changes since a given date, grouped by severity, in English or German. Useful for weekly compliance reviews or audit prep. Returns Markdown plus event_count (events in the digest) and total_matching. Without a key the digest holds the 10 most severe

tools.name: lookup_article
tools.description: Look up a reference to Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (e.g. "Art. 53(1)(d)", "Annex III", "Recital 60") and return related events plus the EUR-Lex URL. Matches whole references: "Art. 5" finds Art. 5 and Art. 5(1)(b), never Art. 50. References the Regulation does not have (Art. 1 to 113, Annex I to XIII,

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "query_ai_act_updates" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
